name: Damián Garcés
tagline: I design and optimize scalable, secure, high-performance backend architectures — and ship the full stack — for the telecom and finance industries.

bio: I'm Damián Garcés — a Senior Backend & Full Stack Developer with over {{years}} years building scalable, secure and high-performance systems for the telecommunications and finance industries.

My core is C#, .NET, Azure, microservices and clean architecture, with full-stack reach into React and Vue. I've delivered platforms that improved system efficiency by 70% and cut operational costs by 40%.
As a technical team lead I mentor engineers and drive architecture decisions that align technology with business goals. Currently based in Chía, Colombia and open to ambitious work.
